newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Acoje, Marsteel price falls stopped.
newsitem.headline: Acoje, Marsteel price falls stopped.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) froze on Thursday the share prices of Acoje Holdings Inc and Marsteel Consolidated Inc as they fell by 40 percent.

The PSE surveillance department said Acoje shares were frozen after falling to 30 centavos, or 40 percent, from 50 centavos and Marsteel shares when it reached 3.6 centavos from six centavos, also a 40 percent drop.
The bourse automatically freezes a share price when an issue falls by 40 percent or when it jumps by about 50 percent in a single trading session.
The Manila bourse had frozen the share price of these two issues early this week as they had risen by nearly 50 percent.

Separately, the Securities and Exchange Commission has asked the PSE to maintain a freeze on the price of Itogon Suyoc Mines Inc shares. A further rise in Itogon A and B share prices were stopped on Wednesday at 24.50 centavos.
The shareprices of the company were frozen for the past five straight sessions as they had reached the 50 percent ceiling.
